target: Exactly the inherited 33-state/25-source alpha, teacher Q_A and four-second natural-future first-CAV-collision event. No original-reset density or source-generalization claim.
fit: Water-fill alpha*sqrt(J) using both completed training branching batches, with q>=alpha/1.1. This is an uncertain candidate, not a certified J model. Fit inputs never enter the prospective objective estimates.
objective: For d_k=alpha_k*(alpha_k/q_k-1), M2(q)-M2(alpha)=loss-benefit. Measure positive d with cheap exact natural futures and negative d with early branching/terminal integration. Retain every state, stratum, negative and competing endpoint.
budget: Benefit inherits each training stratum's coefficient-minimax root count (256/state). Loss and neutral strata use max(2,ceil(d_positive*C_h/1e-5)) natural roots, capped at 60000/batch before outcomes. Fixed planned root bounds direct uncertainty spending, not event-dependent extension.
bets: One benefit rate is chosen from logspace(1,9,81) by maximizing the minimum training-batch lower expression. Loss rate is 0.8/max(planned loss root bound). Both fixed before any evaluation. One-sided non-IID nonnegative-product/Markov bounds use error 0.0125 per side/batch; family confidence 95%. Leaves never count as independent roots. No optional stopping.
decision: Require negative loss_upper-benefit_lower in BOTH complete independent batches. Otherwise retain alpha. Per-state precision failures remain documented but do not replace this prospective objective certificate. Certifies only the fixed-bank conditional M2/variance difference, not population performance.
smoke: Always run two 2112-draw IID arms, alpha and frozen q, after objective collection, regardless of certificate status. Same continuation uniforms/seeds, identical state/seed paths reused. Log full state/action likelihood. Finite-arm variance ordering is descriptive, not the decision criterion.
scope: Training-only prospective experiment, not a repeat of fixed-count measurements. Do not launch until complete parent evidence is independently audited, protocol hash filled, and code/configuration committed/frozen. No PPO, production change, fitting on consumed validation/test, clipping, discarding sources, adaptive extra batches or selective restart. Raw outputs ignored.
